deepDiveBlocks.heading: Specialist Pharmacy Scope
paragraphs: Specialist pharmacy services extend access to advanced clinical care within qualified pharmacist scope — including independent prescribing and occupational health programmes where commissioned.
Scope boundaries are explained clearly so patients understand what can be managed in pharmacy versus when GP or specialist referral is required.

preparationGuide: Employer occupational health forms if applicable
comparisonPoints: Pharmacist prescribing complements but does not replace GP care
Corporate programmes may have separate booking processes
expandedFaqQuestions: What qualifications do your prescribers hold?
Which conditions can be treated in pharmacy?
Can my employer arrange this service?
